declarations.name: AuiTimePicker
declarations.description:
AbsoluteUI TimePicker: `<aui-time-picker>`.
Implements ControlValueAccessor and Validator (error key `aui`); `[(value)]` without forms.

inputs.name: label
inputs.description: Visible label and accessible name of the group (via aria-labelledby).

inputs.name: hideLabel
inputs.description: Visually hide the label; it remains the accessible name.

inputs.name: min
inputs.description: Earliest allowed time (inclusive); first suggestion. Must not be after max.

inputs.name: max
inputs.description: Latest allowed time (inclusive); last possible suggestion.

inputs.name: name
inputs.description: Form field name for the hidden input (HH:MM or HH:MM:SS).

inputs.name: description
inputs.description: Help text referenced by the group's aria-describedby.

inputs.name: required
inputs.description: An empty entry is invalid; segments are required and the required indicator is shown.

inputs.name: disabled
inputs.description: Disables segments and the button; not submitted.

inputs.name: readOnly
inputs.description: Focusable and submitted; not editable and the listbox does not open.

inputs.name: validate
inputs.description: Consumer validation after built-in checks; return a message to mark the value invalid.

inputs.name: validationTiming
inputs.description: When validation messages first appear; afterwards they update live.

inputs.name: hourCycle
inputs.description: 12- or 24-hour entry and display; 'auto' follows the locale.

inputs.name: step
inputs.description: Minutes between suggested times (integer 1..720). Does not constrain typed values.

inputs.name: locale
inputs.description: Segment order, hour cycle (auto), day periods, option labels, and messages.

inputs.name: direction
inputs.description: Listbox alignment direction (applied when the listbox opens).

models.name: value
models.description: The value: `[(value)]` without forms; with Angular forms, bind the form control instead.

outputs.name: changed
outputs.description: The user changed the value or its validity (typing, stepping, or choosing a suggestion).

properties.name: isOpen
properties.description: Read-only: Whether the listbox is shown.

properties.name: formState
properties.description: Angular form state of this control.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Show the listbox and focus it; the option nearest the value (or the first) becomes active.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Hide the listbox without changing the value; focus inside it returns to the button.

methods.name: reportValidity
methods.description: Show messages now and return validity.

methods.name: setCustomError
methods.description: External error (server, cross-field rule); cleared when the user edits.

methods.name: getFormValue
methods.description: HH:MM (HH:MM:SS at second granularity), or null.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Close, restore the initial value, and clear dirty/touched/submitted state.

accessibility.pattern: Segmented time field in a labelled group (as Date Input) with a button that opens a WAI-ARIA APG listbox popup: focus moves into the single-select listbox, which conveys the active option through aria-activedescendant.

limitations: min must not be after max: ranges that cross midnight are not supported.
Suggestions are built on open and are not virtualized; the maximum is 1,440 (step 1).
Typed values do not have to align with step; step only controls the suggestions.
Only ASCII digits are accepted in segments; locale digits (for example Arabic-Indic) are not parsed.
Day periods whose localized forms share a first character (for example Korean 오전/오후) need the full text, Latin a/p, or ArrowUp/ArrowDown.
Milliseconds are not supported; values must have millisecond 0.
